subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Although the jury system is fundamentally ______, no one has ever come up with a better one.
solution:
The correct answer is "flawed."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word** "fundamentally"** indicates that the sentence is discussing the basic nature or essence of the jury system.
 
• The term **"flawed"** means having weaknesses or imperfections. (कमज़ोरियाँ या खामियाँ होना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it suggests that while the jury system may have inherent problems or shortcomings, it is still considered the best available option compared to other systems.
 
• Therefore,** "flawed"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct sentence**: *Although the jury system is fundamentally **flawed**__, no one has ever come up with a better one.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Flawless: **perfect; with no faults or mistakes. (परिपूर्ण; निर्दोष)
 
• **Sorted: **describe a situation in which everything is correctly organized or repaired, or when someone has everything that is needed. (ऐसी स्थिति का वर्णन करें जिसमें सब कुछ सही ढंग से व्यवस्थित या मरम्मत किया गया हो, या जब किसी के पास वह सब कुछ हो जिसकी उसे आवश्यकता है)
 
• **Appealing: **attractive or interesting. (आकर्षक, रुचिकर)
